title: Turn 100 reviews into a month of ad hooks (2 prompts)
caption: Your best ad is already written. It's hiding in your reviews. Both prompts are on screen, screenshot them. #adcreative #aitools #ecommercemarketing #facebookads

beats.headline: Your best ad is *hiding.*
beats.say: Your best-performing ad is already written. It's hiding in your *reviews.*

beats.headline: Reviews → *ad hooks*
beats.say: Two prompts turn a hundred reviews into a month of ad *angles.*

beats.headline: Stop guessing | your *ads.*
beats.say: Stop guessing what to say in your *ads.*

beats.headline: Step three is | where it *pays.*
beats.say: Three steps. Step three is where it *pays.*
One. *Export* your reviews from your reviews app, or copy your competitor's from their product pages. Keep the one-star reviews too. Trust me.

visual.prompt: Here are 100 customer reviews. Group them into the top 5 reasons people bought. Quote their exact words.

beats.say: Two. *Paste* them into any AI and say: group these into the top five reasons people bought, and quote their exact words.

visual.prompt: For each reason, write 3 ad hooks under 10 words. Use the customers' exact phrases.

beats.say: [surprise-oh] Three. *Ask* it: for each reason, write three ad hooks under ten words, using the customers' exact phrases. That's fifteen hooks, written by real buyers.

beats.headline: Which one *stops* you?
beats.say: *Which* ad would you stop scrolling for? Exactly. [laughter]
Bonus. Every one-star complaint is an *objection.* Runs small? Your ad says true to size. Slow shipping? Say ships in two days. Only if it's true.

beats.headline: Your buyers write | *better* ads.
beats.say: Your buyers write better ads than you *do.*

beats.label: Screenshot the prompts
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* these prompts, and follow for more AI ad tricks.
